meta_title: Cut 'n' Edge Garden Services | Gardeners Leeds
meta_description: Cut 'n' Edge Garden Services Ltd in Leeds. Expert garden maintenance, landscaping, and tree work. Local, reliable, fully insured. Call today for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: Fully Insured & Local to Leeds — Over 15 Years' Experience
hero_subhead: From overgrown lawns to complete landscaping—we transform gardens across Leeds and get yours looking immaculate.
services_subhead: Whether it's weekly maintenance, hedge trimming, landscaping, or tree surgery, we handle every job with care and expertise.

services.title: Regular Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Weekly or fortnightly lawn mowing, hedge trimming, and weeding. We keep your garden looking sharp year-round, adapting to the seasons.

services.title: Landscaping & Garden Design
services.desc: Transform tired spaces into outdoor rooms. Paving, decking, raised beds, and bespoke planting schemes tailored to your style and budget.

services.title: Tree Surgery & Felling
services.desc: Safe removal, crown reduction, and stump grinding. All work carried out by experienced arborists with full insurance cover.

services.title: Hedge Cutting & Topiary
services.desc: Neat, professionally trimmed hedges enhance any property boundary. We handle everything from informal borders to formal topiary shapes.

services.title: Garden Clearance
services.desc: Reclaim overgrown gardens from rubble, broken fencing, and years of neglect. We clear, dispose of waste responsibly, and leave you a blank canvas.

services.title: Jet Washing & Patio Cleaning
services.desc: Bring tired patios, driveways, and decking back to life. High-pressure cleaning removes algae, moss, and grime safely.

about_pullquote: I started this because I saw too many gardens left neglected. We treat yours like our own.
about_para_1: Cut 'n' Edge Garden Services was founded over 15 years ago by a team of dedicated gardeners and horticulturists serving Moortown, Leeds, and surrounding areas. What started as a two-person operation has grown into a respected local business, completing over 800 garden transformations and earning a reputation for reliability, attention to detail, and fair pricing.
about_para_2: Our customers stay with us because we listen. We don't push unnecessary work or use high-pressure sales tactics. Whether you need fortnightly lawn care or a complete garden redesign, we deliver honest advice and quality craftsmanship every time. Many of our best work comes from repeat customers and word-of-mouth referrals across Leeds.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had our garden completely overgrown for two years after my dad passed. Cut 'n' Edge cleared it all, sorted the patio, and made it somewhere we actually want to sit again. The lads were respectful, worked hard, and didn't overcharge. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Been using them for lawn care every fortnight for three years now. Always turn up on time, do a proper job, and the price hasn't crept up. You don't get that reliability everywhere. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David H.

reviews.text: Got quotes from three other firms for a new patio and planting scheme. Cut 'n' Edge came in competitively and the result is even better than we imagined. They explained everything clearly and finished on schedule. Will be back for more work.
reviews.author: Rachel M.

address_sub: Serving Moortown, Chapel Allerton, Alwoodley, and all of Leeds and surrounding areas.
